issues.issue: Should the deemed discontinuance be set aside and an extension of time granted under the Hennelly factors?
issues.applicant_position: Counsel's diary oversight explains the delay; continuing intention shown by counsel's affidavit.
issues.respondent_position: Counsel oversight is no reasonable explanation; merit not shown; prejudice inferred from delay.
issues.result_quote: the Applicants have not met the test for an extension of time, and this motion will be dismissed.
